messages:
sam.r: Kickoff - FinWave wants a 2-week Private deploy POC. Requirements: preserve client src IP, allow TLS inspection in their DMZ, and automatic fallback to a proxy if PrivateLink is blocked. They want minimal firewall rules and a note on cost impacts.

ben.n: PrivateLink is simplest to onboard but src IP is preserved only if there's no SNAT/proxy in the path. If they route through a NAT/proxy we will see proxy IPs instead of original client IP.

maria.s: My recommendation: PrivateLink-first with a documented proxy fallback. Ask them for VPC CIDRs, TGW topology, and proxy/NAT IPs so we can produce exact ENI and SG entries.

kevin.t: Security callout: confirm whether their TLS inspector reissues certs. If it does, any mTLS we rely on will break unless we trust their reissued CA or deploy inside their subnet. Also request CA chain and cert pinning guidance.

olivia.k: Minimal SG/ACL guidance to paste:
- PrivateLink: Outbound TCP 443 -> <interface-endpoint-ENI-IPs>
- Peering/TGW: Allow 443 (and 10250 if k8s health checks required) between VPC CIDRs
- Proxy fallback: Allow outbound to proxy IPs on 443 and proxy -> endpoint on 443
Also: Add private DNS override (Route53) so service DNS resolves to endpoint IPs.

jess.s: Commercial note: include PrivateLink endpoint hourly charges and per-GB processing in the SOW; add a clause that customer covers cloud provider egress/NAT bandwidth.

sam.r: Actions: Maria/Ben draft network runbook + SG snippets by EOD tomorrow; Kevin list security Qs; Jess add cost caveat to SOW; I'll request a sanitized network diagram and post it here.

ben.n: Runbook should include quick detection tests (curl to endpoint to verify X-Forwarded-For or source IP) and a toggle for proxy fallback.

sam.r: Thanks all, posting diagram when received and we'll lock the design.
